yourNature_desc: You are the green on the old stone wall that finds a window wherever a door won't give. You run on less Wood than your reach asks for, and you make a little go a long way. Since you need your strength to last, you would rather hold back than spend it on a push that empties you. You keep going on that care, and you pay only in the distance you rarely test.

self_card.face: Green held close to the stone
self_card.presence: You save your strength for what counts and get by on less. Since you rarely admit the strain, you stay upright on that thrift longer than anyone guesses.
